home.name: Devon Levi
home.news: Levi is coming off his worst performance since opening night, allowing seven goals on 36 shots (.806 SV%) in Saturday's 7-4 loss to the Carolina Hurricanes. The 24-year-old goalie has been consistent most of the season, so Tuesday's game against the Vegas Golden Knights will be a good test of how he responds. Before his most recent blip, Levi was on a solid run, posting a 2.08 GAA and .923 SV% in an 11-game stretch (9-2-0). The Oilers enter Tuesday's game as +104 home underdogs against a Golden Knights team that snapped a four-game losing skid (0-1-3) on Saturday with a 5-4 win over the Winnipeg Jets.
